signs.legend: P with red circle and slash
signs.use: no parking where a word sign won't fit

signs.name: PARK & RIDE
signs.use: the way to a park-and-ride lot

signs.name: PARKING (guide)
signs.use: the way to a public lot

signs.name: DEAD END
signs.use: a street with no way through

signs.name: NO OUTLET
signs.use: the mouth of a cul-de-sac or loop with one way out

signs.name: TRAM STOP (city design)
signs.legend: the city transit authority's own stop flag (not a MUTCD regulatory sign: stop flags are the agency's)

port_carrow.stop_flag: navy rectangle, white tram symbol in a white ring, a bronze stripe at the foot; route numbers in white boxes
port_carrow.shape: rectangle 450 x 600 mm on its own post

kessler.stop_flag: red roundel on a white disc, a white tram symbol on the bar, the stop name below in a white panel
kessler.shape: round 600 mm disc over a 300 x 450 mm name panel

solana_point.stop_flag: sun-yellow pennant shape, black tram symbol, the stop name in Spanish and English

harrow_falls.stop_flag: green shield (the old mill-town crest), white tram symbol, a white band with the stop name

brightwater.stop_flag: teal lollipop disc with a cream rim, white tram symbol, the stop name on a cream bar
brightwater.shape: disc 550 mm over a bar 600 x 150 mm

oceanview.stop_flag: orange square, white tram symbol, a white route strip; the stop name on a blue plate
oceanview.shape: square 500 mm over a plate 500 x 150 mm
